A little clarity

Your questions, answered

Have a question about your own situation? April answers personally.

Ask April
How do I contact April Johnson about buying a home?

Use the message form and choose buying. Include your preferred areas, property requirements and timing if you know them.

How do I request a seller consultation?

Choose selling on the contact form and share your property address and intended timeframe. You can also use the home-value page if pricing is your first question.

Can I request a consultation time online?

Yes. Include your preferred times in the form. Your appointment is not confirmed until you receive a confirmation.

What information should I include in my message?

Include the type of transaction, location, timing and the question you want to discuss. A property address or listing link is helpful when you have one.

Can I contact April before I am ready to buy or sell?

Yes. Tell me what you are considering and what you need to understand before making a decision.
